Axiom: Forbidden Svelte 4 patterns in new components: `export let prop`, `$:` reactive statements, `on:event` directives, `` and `$$slots`, `$$props` / `$$restProps`, `createEventDispatcher`, `dispatch`. Each has a Svelte 5 replacement (`$props()`, `$derived` / `$effect`, attribute handlers, `{#snippet}` + `{@render}`, callback props).
